patthana8.13:1.1: nae kanaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kenaciviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kenacinaviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kenaciviññeyyo ca na kenacinaviññeyyo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana8.13:2.1: na kenacinaviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kenacinaviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana8.13:3.1: na kenaciviññeyyañca na kenacinaviññeyyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na kenaciviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana8.13:4.1: hetuyā nava avigate nava sabbattha vitthāro.
